candidates.reason: The screenshot is a direct mobile app screen capture. The boundary is the requested viewport, not a decorative presentation wrapper.

global.notes: The screen uses a soft editorial serif for product copy. Low-visual-weight body/supporting text uses the global serif fallback.

digit_style.evidence: The price numerals have narrow proportions, bracketed serif terminals, and higher stroke contrast than the body copy.

high_visual_weight_text.evidence: The current price is the largest text after the product image and carries the main commercial hierarchy.

high_visual_weight_text.evidence: The original price sits next to the sale price and remains a high-weight commercial numeric element.

availability.selected_stack: Didot, Bodoni 72, Bodoni 72 Oldstyle, Times New Roman, Georgia, serif

ring.background_handling: The product card background and warm bottom gradient are recreated in CSS. They are not baked into the ring asset.

source_subject_visual_bbox_px.measurement: source screenshot threshold measurement inside crop 300x300+130+250

ring.rendering_basis: Render by matching the source subject visual bbox, not by sizing the full transparent PNG canvas to the old tight-crop box.

trim.reason: The alpha PNG preserves transparent padding. Running ImageMagick trim would discard placement information; the CSS image box is instead derived from source subject bbox divided by the asset alpha fill ratio.

ring.notes: The generated image used a flat chroma-key background and was post-processed to alpha without ImageMagick trim. Earlier artifacts that described a trimmed PNG were stale.
